title: Blue Razz Berry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid by Seriously Fruity
description:
Seriously Fruity Blue Razz Berry 100ml Shortfill is a vibrant blend of blue raspberry with a candy twist. A tangy and sweet flavour throughout, with the perfect balance between fruit and candy.
Seriously Fruity Shortfills are brought to you by the team at. justvapesaustralia.Supplied in a 120ml shortfill bottle, containing 100ml of zero nicotine e-liquid. Simply mix in two 18mg nicotine shots to create an overall 3mg strength.
